privacy: Neutral synthetic cases and private local reports only; no secrets, downloads or production effects.
title: T10 — Adopt identity-bound ledger coverage
goal: Pin the Gauntlet release that closes gauntlet-protocol B-002, so a case becomes pending when its model digest, runtime, machine scenario or (for system cases) NERV source changes, and reuse never depends on a timer
acceptance: Pin the release; `gauntlet ledger record` passes NERV's source key (from the existing evaluate.mjs source inputs) for system cases
`pending`, `gauntlet:all` and `check:gauntlet-runs` pass the intended model digest, runtime, scenario and source key, and the plan names the new reasons
A NERV source change makes the affected system cases pending; schema 1 ledger entries are reported as unknown identity, not silently covering
No default max age (owner 2026-11-11); `--max-age-days` stays opt-in
validation: Join test across the vendored release, the ledger, NERV's source key and check:gauntlet-runs: a source edit in a fixture makes a system case pending
escalation: Upstream dependency: voidbrain/gauntlet-protocol B-002 release (PR #36 plans it, about 1 focused day)
A schema 1 ledger re-run is an owner-approved campaign like F-074-T09

effort.basis: Owner 2026-11-11 asked to plan the F-074-T08 known limit. Adoption mirrors T07 (pin, pass options, join test). Estimate, not a measurement. Numbers backfilled 2026-11-11 at harness 5.4.0 from this estimate (rounded up to a quarter day); the baseline is this estimate, not an original one. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 0.75 hours agent; pin and adopt after the upstream release; one PR. Method: NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge: median 0.56 h, p75 2.1 h, p90 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement) put a focused day at about 1.5 agent hours, with 0.75 h the least for one PR with review and CI. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 0.5 kept as history.
